exposure: Existing project-wide automation access dictionary key appeared in tool output during protection metadata inspection. Value not repeated or copied into repository.
scope: Hosting access to existing project deployments; application identity, MFA and tenant authorization remain independently enforced.
containment: Do not output or publish provider protectionBypass dictionary keys.
All subsequent policy comparisons hash the complete private object.
New QA caller access uses a different fresh 15-minute deployment-specific credential.
requiredAction: Under explicit production authorization, inventory dependent automation privately, replace the exposed project-wide automation credential, validate bounded consumers, then revoke the exposed credential. No automatic rotation while production changes are prohibited.
